title: The Road From The Ashes
premise: A wanderer wakes in the ashes and walks toward a far fire that never went out. Every step feeds the flame.

chapters.title: The Ashen Plain
chapters.intro: Grey flats where the last fire died. Every step here is the first one.

chapters.title: Cinderwood
chapters.intro: A burnt forest that remembers the heat. Embers still glow under the roots.

chapters.title: The Salt Roads
chapters.intro: White highways laid by travellers long gone. Wind scours them clean.

chapters.title: The Glass Hills
chapters.intro: Lightning once struck here and never stopped. The ground rings underfoot.

chapters.title: The Drowned Spires
chapters.intro: Towers wade in black water. Something below keeps the bells.

chapters.title: The Long Dark
chapters.intro: No sun for a month of walking. Your flame is the only lamp.

chapters.title: The Sunward Stair
chapters.intro: Terraces climb toward a light you can finally see.

waypoints.name: Cold Hearth
waypoints.text: The ashes where you woke. The hearthstones are still warm.

waypoints.name: Cinder Gate
waypoints.text: A broken arch. Beyond it, the road begins.

waypoints.name: The Hollow Well
waypoints.text: The water is dry but the stones hum when you drop an ember in.

waypoints.name: Edge of Cinderwood
waypoints.text: Black trunks stand like pillars. The air smells of old smoke.

waypoints.name: Charred Chapel
waypoints.text: A roofless shrine. Someone left a lantern burning here.

waypoints.name: Lantern Glade
waypoints.text: Hundreds of glass lanterns hang from the branches, all dark.

waypoints.name: The Woodcutter's Rest
waypoints.text: A cabin with two chairs. One is still warm.

waypoints.name: Saltgate
waypoints.text: The road turns white and the forest ends at a line.

waypoints.name: The Pale Caravan
waypoints.text: Wagons, frozen mid-journey, loaded with salt and silence.

waypoints.name: Mirror Flats
waypoints.text: The sky lies on the ground. You walk across clouds.

waypoints.name: Foot of the Glass Hills
waypoints.text: The first slope glitters like a field of knives.

waypoints.name: The Singing Shard
waypoints.text: A tall crystal that hums your footsteps back to you.

waypoints.name: Hermit's Kiln
waypoints.text: A smith who has not spoken in years offers a seat by the fire.

waypoints.name: The Glass Overlook
waypoints.text: From here you can see the water that waits below.

waypoints.name: The Drowned Stair
waypoints.text: Steps descend into black water. The road goes on underneath.

waypoints.name: Bellfall
waypoints.text: A tower of bells, every one cracked, all still ringing softly.

waypoints.name: The Sunken Library
waypoints.text: Shelves under water. The books are dry.

waypoints.name: Lastlight Pass
waypoints.text: The sun sets behind the mountains and does not rise again.

waypoints.name: The Quiet Mile
waypoints.text: Sound stops. Your heartbeat is the only thing left.

waypoints.name: Wolfmoon Camp
waypoints.text: A circle of stones. Others have waited out the dark here.

waypoints.name: Foot of the Sunward Stair
waypoints.text: Dawn at last, thin and gold on the highest steps.

waypoints.name: Ember Terraces
waypoints.text: Gardens of living coals climb the mountainside.

waypoints.name: The Last Shrine
waypoints.text: One more shrine, where the road asks what you came for.

waypoints.name: The First Flame
waypoints.text: Where all fires began. It has been waiting for you.

scenes.arrive: The shrine is a ring of cold stones. Three sealed cards wait on the altar.
scenes.lost: The ashes swallow the week. The stones are patient.
scenes.won: You press the last ember into the stone. The plain grows a little warmer.

scenes.arrive: Charred beams frame the shrine. Three cards lie sealed among the cinders.
scenes.lost: The forest forgets this week. It will wait for your return.
scenes.won: Sparks leap from the cards into the dead branches. Something stirs.

scenes.arrive: A salt-white altar under open sky. Three cards, sealed in wax.
scenes.lost: The wind scours the week away. Try again.
scenes.won: The salt glitters as the card burns. The road feels shorter.

scenes.arrive: The shrine hums, a shard of glass at its heart. Three cards wait.
scenes.lost: The glass goes dull. The hills do not hold grudges.
scenes.won: The shard rings out. The whole hillside answers.

scenes.arrive: The shrine stands above the waterline. Three sealed cards drip in the dark.
scenes.lost: The water takes the week. The bells keep time without you.
scenes.won: The bells ring once for you. The water stills.

scenes.arrive: Your flame lights the shrine. Three cards, sealed against the dark.
scenes.lost: The dark grows heavier this week. Your flame holds.
scenes.won: The dark leans back from the light. Just a little.

scenes.arrive: The shrine glows gold. Three sealed cards wait in the light.
scenes.lost: Even here a week can slip. The stair does not mind.
scenes.won: The cards burn bright. The summit seems closer.
